pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Mustard Boy's dream of goal-scoring oil fields dries up faster than his Saudi Arabia pick.** So, Zach's sittin' pretty in third with 35 points, but man, the way Austria just got steamrolled by Spain, you'd think he believed in fairy tales. Gunner, though—that's Bubba G, y'all—cruisin' at the top with 47 points. Bet he's smilin' like he knows somethin' we don’t, like he found gold in pickin' DR Congo just 'cause his barber said they got flair. Meanwhile, The Backpass Assassin's just back-passin' his chances of trophies away, sittin' fourth with an empty 31 points, probably replayin' Japan’s every beautiful back pass in slow motion. And Rafe, "The Noisemaker," bringin' up the rear like he picked Germany just 'cause he thought Bavaria was a beach. Dee Ghost Pepper, keepin' it spicy in second place with a solid 42, ridin' on Spain’s shoulders like he knows what he's doin'. Gettin' tight up top with Gunner, but man, Mustard Boy better hope Switzerland keeps deliverin' 'cause that oil ain't comin' in.
